Nina (CS): Kickoff for Sentinel dedicated bring-up TOMORROW 04:00 UTC. Scope: quota handoff, staged loadtests, autoscale tuning, and renewal feedback capture. Who is point during 04:00-06:00?

Raj (Infra): I can own infra ops. Pool info: pool-id=sentinel-ded-01, template=reserved-a100v4-dense, slots=6, spare=2. Ill create reservation and attach manifest.

Jon (SE): Ill run the staged load scripts and collect perf samples. Plan: smoke 5m, canary 15m at low qps, ramp to target for 25m, then soak. Need canary API key + KMS unseal window 03:50-04:15 UTC.

Eve (SRE): Autoscale suggestion: min_replicas=2, target_util=65%, max_replicas=10, scale_up_cooldown=100s. Add queue_length signal with threshold 1200 and p95 latency alert at 330ms. Add rollback quickscript that re-routes to hosted with traffic-shift step.

Nina (CS): Customer requested a one-off warmup credit and a post-run feedback call. Ill document both. Also need someone to post near-real-time status to the customer channel.

Raj (Infra): Reservation + warmup commands:

Raj (Infra): ```
redwoodctl reserve create --pool sentinel-ded-01 --slots 6 --duration 6h --note "sentinel-onramp"
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool sentinel-ded-01 --profile cache-warm --concurrency 6
```

scheduler-bot: Load job scheduled: id=1781234567-load for 2026-05-05T04:10:00Z by @Jon. Logs will post here.

Jon (SE): Smoke curl (token will be replaced at runtime):

Jon (SE): ```
curl -s -X POST https://sentinel.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer CANARY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"smoke"}'
```

Eve (SRE): Fallback policy: if error_rate > 1% for > 3m or p95 > 400ms -> shift 25% traffic to hosted-quantized fallback, notify #eng-oncall and pause ramp. Also set max-fallback-rate=30% for first 2h.

Nina (CS): Who will handle customer comms? Ill draft the initial blurb but need live updates.

Raj (Infra): Ill post infra/warmup confirmations and reservation link. Alerts: quota@85% -> #customer-success, #eng-oncall.

Jon (SE): After run Ill upload summary: p95, error_rate, token consumption, and a small prompt set used for quality checks. Ill also attach a short feedback form link.

Nina (CS): Great. Final pre-run checklist: 1) KMS unseal window confirmed (Raj) 2) Canary key issued (Jon) 3) Reservation created (Raj) 4) Runbook + rollback snippet present (Eve) 5) Billing buffer noted (Nina). Ping me if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
